title: While the grid is in edit the simulator uses the unsaved values
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Have a new matrix for this test, matrix A, pricing a new category made for this test, category A, one range from $0.00 with Default on Markup % 50.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Matrices tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Click matrix A's name on the Matrices list.
  3. Click Edit.
  4. Type 60 in Default's first range.
  5. Click Cancel.
  6. Click Discard Changes.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Matrix A is listed.

Step 2:

  • Matrix A's page opens on the Work Order Matrix tab.
  • Default's simulator price reads $150.00 ($100.00 × 1.50 = $150.00).

Step 3:

  • The grid is in edit and the simulator still shows under it.

Step 4:

  • Before saving, Default's simulator price reads $160.00 and "$60.00 profit" ($100.00 × 1.60 = $160.00).

Step 5:

  • A question asks "Discard These Changes?" with Keep Editing and Discard Changes.

Step 6:

  • The grid is back in view with Default on 50% markup.
  • Default's simulator price reads $150.00 again.
